nodes.description: Normally, AUG codons in the THPO 5' untranslated region define short upstream open reading frames that capture scanning ribosomes and keep initiation at the thrombopoietin start codon low, so the two main mRNA isoforms are almost completely repressed. Removing or disabling the repressive ORF7 releases this brake.

nodes.description: Mice that keep Mpl on stem and progenitor cells but lack it on megakaryocytes and platelets develop megakaryocytosis and thrombocytosis from thrombopoietin that the platelet compartment no longer consumes, with a normal circulating level. It models the response of the progenitor compartment to chronic thrombopoietin overstimulation, not the THPO lesion. No knock-in of a human THPO 5' untranslated region variant has been reported in any species.

nodes.description: A full-length Mpl transgene whose expression falls during late megakaryocyte maturation leaves little Mpl protein in platelets. It is the closest available model of the reduced platelet MPL arm of this disease.

nodes.description: Platelets from affected family members have low MPL protein with normal MPL mRNA. The authors of the Polish and Dutch series propose that the loss follows from increased internalization and degradation of the receptor-ligand complex under chronic ligand excess (PMID:18367486, Discussion), which is the incoming edge drawn from the raised thrombopoietin level.
